title: Music Recommendation System Using Collaborative Filtering and Matrix Factorization Through LightFM
authors: de Goma, J. C.; Bermudez, J. C.; Ordonio, R. M.
tldr: Develops a music recommendation system using LightFM (hybrid collaborative + content-based matrix factorization) with Philippine OPM music data, achieving 96.8% top-5 accuracy.
problem_and_motivation: Discovering new music matching individual preferences is challenging due to content overload. Existing recommendation systems lack hybrid approaches that combine collaborative and content-based features for improved accuracy.
approach: Used LightFM library implementing hybrid matrix factorization with both collaborative and content-based features.
Dataset: user-song interaction data from Last.fm including 108 OPM (Original Pilipino Music) songs and user demographic features.
Preprocessed data: encoded user features (age, gender, location) and song metadata (genre, artist, era).
Trained LightFM model with WARP (Weighted Approximate-Rank Pairwise) loss function.
Evaluated using precision@k, recall@k, and AUC metrics with k=5 and k=10.
Compared against pure collaborative filtering (SVD) and pure content-based (Cosine Similarity) baselines.
findings: num: LightFM achieved 96.8% precision@5 and 94.2% precision@10, outperforming both baselines.
LightFM improved recall by 18% over SVD collaborative filtering.
Hybrid approach effectively handles cold-start problem for new users with demographic features.
WARP loss function optimized for ranking quality outperformed logistic loss.
Content features most important for recommendation: genre and era metadata.

key_equations.explanation: LightFM prediction: sigmoid of user bias + item bias + dot product of user and item latent vectors.

key_equations.equation: L_{WARP} = Σ rank(i) · max(0, 1 - P(u,i) + P(u,j))
key_equations.explanation: WARP loss penalizes ranking errors where negative item j is ranked above positive item i.

definitions.definition: Hybrid matrix factorization model combining collaborative filtering with content-based features for recommendation.
Weighted Approximate-Rank Pairwise loss — optimizes for top-k ranking quality by sampling negative items until a ranking violation is found.
Difficulty recommending items to new users or recommending new items with no interaction history.

topic_relevance.contribution_to_field: While applied to music recommendation, the LightFM hybrid approach and WARP loss optimization are directly transferable to PFMS recommendation tasks such as personalized budget plans, savings goals, or financial product recommendations. The paper demonstrates handling cold-start with user demographic features—a common PFMS challenge.
directly_justifies: Hybrid matrix factorization (LightFM) outperforms pure collaborative or content-based approaches.
User demographic features effectively mitigate cold-start problems.
WARP loss optimizes for top-k recommendation quality preferred in PFMS scenarios.
